## Synopsis

An AI agent that calls a server behind Microsoft Entra acts there as an Entra agent identity. Its client id is a GUID that Entra assigns, so Straza keeps it on the agent's record. An identity manager can write it over SCIM as entraAgentId instead.

```
strazactl users entra-agent-id [flags]
```

## Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --server string   strazad base URL (overrides $STRAZA_SERVER)
```

* [strazactl users entra-agent-id show](/reference/cli/strazactl/strazactl_users_entra-agent-id_show/): Show the Entra agent identity the agent acts as
* [strazactl users entra-agent-id unset](/reference/cli/strazactl/strazactl_users_entra-agent-id_unset/): Clear the agent's Entra agent identity
